dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Oh my~ If it isn't my old acquaintance. Did you come all this way during Lantern Rite to see me?

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Of course, you look as lovely as ever.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: It's just a shame that we're so busy, even though it's the festival period...

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: But either way, why don't you feast your eyes on what we've got in store? Who knows, you might chance upon some extra benefits.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: I mean, I'm just a slap of lipstick and a dab of makeup compared to these beauties.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Well hello, you're looking rather fetching today. Care to take a look inside Scent of Spring? I'm sure you'll find something unforgettable~!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait, is this a...

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Of course! As you would expect. The real deal.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: You didn't know? They let us open our own little hideaways, nothing to worry about.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Just imagine, the warmth of their bodies, the smoothness of their curves under your hands...

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Pretty as they are, you can't have them out and about, it's not appropriate. I have to get them baked for twelve hours before I can even open shop...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait, did you just say "baked"?

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Of course! I mean, not as intensely as those other places, but once I've got them ready, they're just as good as anywhere else.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: All our very best are as I described; full and elegant bodies, thinner up top, but curvaceous further down. It's what everybody is asking for these days...

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: The clients that I have come and pick their favorite and then off they go! They're always so glowing and satisfied when they're done.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, ahh, I'll... I'll pass.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Oh come now, why so stuffy? No one likes someone who can't appreciate and enjoy true beauty!

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Well hello there, stranger... Did you come all this way just to see me?

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Shame — this girl's still got to work. If only it were after hours...

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Why don't you come feast your eyes on what we've got in store? I'm just a slap of lipstick and a dab of makeup compared to these beauties.
